research.primary: candidate minus same frozen predecessor, mean custom rank utility across four initial seat rotations per seed block, vs three frozen S42-adapter opponents
research.formal_seed_blocks_rule: Before first target candidate training/evaluation freeze 160 new blocks (1280 hanchan) per cycle, using 135-block conservative approx planning estimate rounded up to 160. If separate pre-candidate variance pilot requires larger N, preregister exact N and rationale before candidate is evaluated; maximum 400. No midrun resampling or sample-size adjustment from candidate outcomes.
research.power_interpretation: 80% approximate power for rejecting zero effect at true +15 with two-sided 5%; cannot claim 80% power to establish effect >=15; additional promotion point-estimate requirement
research.gate: promote research only if lower 95% paired seed-block bootstrap CI >0 AND point estimate >=15, no severe regressions/correctness issues; if upper CI <15 then futility for that candidate; otherwise inconclusive; at budget cap freeze regardless; maximum 2 cycles, no optional stopping
research.ci: paired whole 4-seat seed-block percentile bootstrap 20,000 replicates fixed RNG seed 261120; point effect and CI; primary single endpoint; secondary by opponent and action category descriptive
research.holdouts: session/seed lineage/campaign/opponent family/version group; freeze train/dev/test manifests and seeds; no pilot pooling; existing 30-match dev and 700 games all development/reference, not fresh confirmation; prevent duplicate seed/hash/near-clones; no future/hidden labels in inference; keep exact model hashes, code SHA, rule hash, seed list, replay hashes; failures retry same seed/model, persistent failure invalidates full run not drop
research.baseline: Explicit S42-adapter (46 actions, legal deterministic detail resolver, guard off; distinct from native original), frozen exact code / weight / rule hash before trial. Native action audit open; if correction changes comparator, rerun symmetry and pilot, refreeze prior to any candidate trial.

product.p1: OOF calibration split by match and campaign; calibrated legal-Ron probability not actual ron choice; p(ron legal) x conditional payment under declared counterfactual rule; use explicit actual loss definition conditioned on accepted ron policy if calling actual loss; no joint probability independence assumptions; no Q-derived physical EV
product.p1_gate: Before training/outer evaluation, freeze calibration/ranking/conditional-loss criteria and stratum support; no unverified point values in UI, uncertainty/small n suppress, no recommendation override; P1 metrics Brier/log loss/reliability/AUPRC, within-decision ranking, conditional point error and risk-loss consistency; dedicated untouched family holdout
product.p2: Mortal unchanged, factual and estimated explanations separately, no causal inference of internal reasoning
product.p2b: small prospective learner transfer pilot, factual accuracy plus independent metrics, not generalizable
product.p3: counterfactual behavior consistency; not claim of internal causality

release_gate: No expanded distribution pending corresponding-source and notice verification; no blanket legal compliance claim; no automatic merge.
